data_boundary: Repository-owned isolated fixture only; values below exclude subscription URLs, credentials, API secrets, generated core configuration and runtime tags.

apply_and_selector_success.operation: The final executable applied the fixture to Ready, then changed the Manual member from node-a to node-b through the production UI and fixed owned Clash API.
apply_and_selector_success.generation_conclusion: The hot-swappable selector mutation persisted node-b without advancing activeConfigurationGeneration.
apply_and_selector_success.visible_result: The node-b row became authoritative selected state and the pool selector state became 运行中 after PUT/GET read-back.

recoverable_apply_failure.setup: A valid structural configuration was applied to Ready before saving one domain-valid but Compiler-invalid IP CIDR matcher.
recoverable_apply_failure.visible_result: 配置检查失败，旧运行配置保持不变
recoverable_apply_failure.conclusion: The saved desired state advanced and remained persisted; pre-stop compile failure preserved the same owned Ready child and its listening API.

runtime_event_invalidation.setup: A valid configuration reached Ready/applied; the owned isolated child was then stopped externally while Proxies held a terminal applied snapshot.
runtime_event_invalidation.visible_result: The page changed from applied/running to 有未应用更改 and 已保存 without a subscription mutation or Apply poll.
runtime_event_invalidation.conclusion: The existing runtime observation event invalidated the authoritative shared Provider snapshot after owned-child exit.

final_webview_ipc_readback.method: The final Tauri WebView2 process was launched with a loopback-only temporary DevTools port; Runtime.evaluate invoked only the existing main-window get/mutate commands and returned a sanitized subset.
final_webview_ipc_readback.conclusion: Reload retained the same persisted dirty state and in-process revision 2. Process restart retained desired Domain state, reset non-persistent routingRevision to 1, exposed no operationId, and both hidden production pages consumed the same Provider snapshot.

final_webview_query_error.setup: Both state.json and its isolated backup were temporarily replaced by invalid one-byte JSON after stopping the process.

cleanup: All isolated application and owned-child processes were stopped; ports 9090 and 9223 had zero listeners; state.json and state.json.bak were reset from the repository fixture; system theme values remained AppsUseLightTheme=1 and SystemUsesLightTheme=1.
